    m=bpy.data.materials.get(name)
    if m: return m
    m=bpy.data.materials.new(name); m.use_nodes=True
    bs=m.node_tree.nodes["Principled BSDF"]
    bs.inputs["Base Color"].default_value=(*color,1)
    bs.inputs["Roughness"].default_value=rough
    bs.inputs["Metallic"].default_value=metal
    bs.inputs["Alpha"].default_value=alpha
    if emissive:
        try:
            bs.inputs["Emission Color"].default_value=(*emissive,1)
            bs.inputs["Emission Strength"].default_value=ei
        except: pass
    if alpha<1:
        m.blend_method='BLEND'
    return m

def tube(name, pts, r0, r1, material, sides=10):
    # Catmull-Rom sampling
    P=[Vector(p) for p in pts]
    # pad ends
    Pext=[P[0]+(P[0]-P[1])]+P+[P[-1]+(P[-1]-P[-2])]
    samples=[]
    segs_per=8
    for i in range(1,len(Pext)-2):
        p0,p1,p2,p3=Pext[i-1],Pext[i],Pext[i+1],Pext[i+2]
        for j in range(segs_per):
            t=j/segs_per; t2=t*t; t3=t2*t
            pt=0.5*((2*p1)+(-p0+p2)*t+(2*p0-5*p1+4*p2-p3)*t2+(-p0+3*p1-3*p2+p3)*t3)
            samples.append(pt)
    samples.append(P[-1])
    verts=[]; faces=[]
    n=len(samples)
    for idx,pt in enumerate(samples):
        t=idx/max(1,n-1)
        r=r0*(1-t)+r1*t
        # taper tip extra
        if idx==n-1: r*=0.4
        # frame
        if idx==0: tangent=(samples[1]-samples[0]).normalized()
        elif idx==n-1: tangent=(samples[-1]-samples[-2]).normalized()
        else: tangent=(samples[idx+1]-samples[idx-1]).normalized()
        up=Vector((0,0,1))
        if abs(tangent.dot(up))>0.9: up=Vector((0,1,0))
        side=tangent.cross(up).normalized()
        up2=side.cross(tangent).normalized()
        for s in range(sides):
            a=2*math.pi*s/sides
            v=pt + (side*math.cos(a)+up2*math.sin(a))*r
            verts.append(tuple(v))
    for i in range(n-1):
        for s in range(sides):
            a=i*sides+s; b=i*sides+(s+1)%sides; c=(i+1)*sides+(s+1)%sides; d=(i+1)*sides+s
            faces.append((a,b,c,d))
    # caps as fans (approx: add center verts)
    mesh=bpy.data.meshes.new(name+"Mesh")
    mesh.from_pydata(verts,[],faces); mesh.update()
    o=bpy.data.objects.new(name,mesh)
    bpy.context.collection.objects.link(o)
    for p in mesh.polygons: p.use_smooth=True
    apply_mat(o,material); return o
